about: M7 deliverable 1, HIT REACTIONS BY ZONE AND DIRECTION (Strategy, 2026-10-27). OPT-IN: ?feel=hitreact (src/fight/feel-hitreact.ts); without it nothing here is read and today's single stagger dip is the whole hit reaction. PRESENTATION ONLY: the sim (duel.ts) and Gate 0 never see it. Today every landed blow is one generic stagger (data/physics.json hit + states.stagger); these rows add, per zone of the blow and per side it came from, which parts' motors dip (strength 0..1, lower = limper), how deep and for how long, how the impulse is split across parts, and how the bones blend back into the clip. Design references (public behaviour only, no code read): Exanima, Half Sword and Hellish Quart, where a blow moves the body part it lands on and the body follows through the joints, not one canned flinch. The flag is the shared feel registry's (src/fight/feel.ts): ?feel=hitreact, alone or in a comma list (armfeel's high|low|off share the key).`frontCos`: the blow's direction, in his own frame, is a front blow when it travels into his chest (its component along his facing is at or beyond -frontCos), a back blow when at or beyond +frontCos, else a side blow (left or right of HIM). `defaultSide`: the side an arm/leg row's `$near` takes on a front or back blow (Left or Right). `zones`: the sim's hit location (head, torso, legs) or `arms` (a blow the rules package puts on an arm) -> a row. A zone row: `dips` part -> the strength that part's motor falls to at the deepest (a part id of the physics package; `$near` = the Left/Right on the side the blow came from); `timing` easeInS / holdS / backS (backS is the blend-back time, the dip's way back up to full strength and the bones' way back to the clip); `blend` part -> the share of the ragdoll's pose shown on that part's bone at the deepest (the clip alone at 0); `impulse` total N s along the blow (before the direction scale and the hit's strength), `lift` N s up, `split` part -> its signed share of the total (positive = pushed along the blow, negative = pulled the other way, so a stomach blow pushes the belly back and tips head and chest forward over it: the fold); `twist` N s of couple for a side blow (the chest one way, the belly the other); `dirs`: front, back, left, right -> `impulse` and `dip` multipliers (dip scales how far below 1 the strength falls) and `twist` multiplier.
